scope: Static control/source/JSON/hash/archive-text review only. Does not attest native preflight, probe, classifier execution or scientific acceptance.

checks.syntax: AST parse of control, original supervisor, scientific supplement and saved preflight/install text passed without imports or execution.
checks.payload: Exactly four fixed text members; each archive member and local source byte length/SHA matches files_to_install_exclusive. No CP/raw/NPZ payload. Exclusive xb installation refuses existing targets and verifies installed hashes.
checks.global_exclusion: Actual argv includes taskset CPU0-3 and nonblocking project flock. Control verifies cwd and exact inherited affinity. Fresh preflight checks expected boot, existing N01 process metadata, lock and registered probe headroom; classify requires a separate resource binding.
checks.process_ownership: Original supervisor starts its timeout child in a new session. Control learns that owned child from supervisor launch.json, binds PID/start ticks/boot/cwd/full argv and verifies identity immediately before each output-overrun group signal. Unknown or changed identity raises without a signal. No unrelated project/process signals or NVML kill threshold.
checks.existing_RSS: Unmodified supervise.py monitors its own child process tree and sends TERM/KILL only to its own child group. New code adds phase output/control accounting rather than a new scientific supervisor.
checks.phase_gate: Probe and classify are separate explicit launch argv. Classify needs the bound engineering PASS SHA; scientific script still applies the strict gate already reviewed. No automatic classifier chain or restart.
checks.frozen_science: Scientific script/config/design bytes match prior SOURCE_REVIEW; classifier protocol and response endpoints unchanged. Original run_01 and control_01 are untouched.

resource_semantics.wall_definition: 180/1800s are timeout TERM thresholds; timeout allows up to20s cleanup before KILL. They are not instantaneous process-disappearance deadlines. Cleanup grace is disclosed and is not a new scientific allocation.
resource_semantics.output_definition: Output+control size is sampled once per second and checked at exit. An overrun triggers TERM then at most20s grace/KILL of the verified owned timeout group and a failed receipt. Sampling/termination can overshoot the threshold; this is not a byte-exact filesystem quota.
resource_semantics.GPU_definition: Frozen scientific script torch allocator caps only, with fresh memory headroom check. No shared-GPU NVML kill threshold.

remaining_native_steps: ROOT/driver may perform the registered fresh preflight, selective exclusive install and bounded probe. A classifier launch requires strict probe PASS and separate fresh resource binding under the same frozen plan.
